# Dilkhush Kirana Store

> Dilkhush Kirana Store (est. 1999) is an authentic Gujarati grocery and specialty food store based in Dhasa Junction, Gujarat, India. Specializing in homemade Saani (black and white sesame paste), traditional Kachariyu, freshly ground pure spices, and daily kitchen essentials with zero artificial preservatives. Fast delivery across Gujarat and India, with online ordering and WhatsApp support.

## Key Facts & Entity Information
- **Business Name**: Dilkhush Kirana Store
- **Website URL**: https://dilkhush-kirana.vercel.app/
- **Founded**: 1999 (25+ years of trusted service)
- **Store Location**: Dhasa Junction, District Bhavnagar / Amreli, Gujarat, 364730, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 97230 89786 / +91 90333 32365
- **Email**: mustakmetar82@gmail.com / muzammilmetar82@gmail.com
- **Google Maps**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/2yeV6Ern1uCUVyEV8
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST; Saturday – Sunday: 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM IST
- **Primary Speciality**: Pure homemade Gujarati Saani, Kachariyu, pure red chilli powder (Marchu), turmeric, coriander-cumin (Dhana-Jeeru), and custom spice mix blends.

## Product Offerings
- **Traditional Saani**: Freshly pounded black sesame Saani (Kala Til Saani) and white sesame Saani (Safed Til Saani), made with organic jaggery (Gud) and pure cold-pressed oil. 100% vegetarian, rich in iron, calcium, and natural winter warmth.
- **Authentic Kachariyu**: Traditional Saurashtra delicacy crafted with premium roasted sesame, natural dry fruits, spices, and unrefined sweeteners. No added preservatives, chemicals, or artificial colours.
- **Pure Spices & Masalas**: Hand-cleaned, sun-dried, and freshly ground red chilli powder (Reshamo / Kashmiri / Guntur varieties), pure Salem turmeric powder (Haldi), fragrant coriander-cumin blend (Dhana-Jeeru), and garam masala.
- **Custom Mix Builder**: Interactive online mix builder (/custom) allowing customers to curate exact spice and ingredient weight ratios according to personal taste and family recipes.
- **Daily Kirana & Staples**: Premium grains, pulses, dry fruits, and household pantry essentials.

## Delivery & Ordering
- **Delivery Coverage**: All towns and cities across Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot, Vadodara, Bhavnagar, Amreli, Junagadh, Jamnagar, Gandhinagar) and pan-India shipping.
- **Delivery Speed**: Orders before 6:00 PM are dispatched same-day. Typical transit is 24-48 hours within Gujarat.
- **Free Delivery**: Free shipping on orders above ₹299.
- **Payment Modes**: Secure online checkout via Razorpay (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, Debit/Credit Cards, Net Banking) and direct WhatsApp orders.
- **Order Tracking**: Real-time package tracking with Order ID at /track-order.
